bitemporal-economic-observations.note: Observations are projected into the shared bitemporal ledger (src/kb/temporal.py).

bitemporal-office-terms.note: query_type officeholder_at_date; terms only written via load_fixture.

bounded-public-osint-acquisition.note: Only the generic declarative-rest/blog runtime; the pack policy block (review_gate, deny_person_identification) is not read anywhere in src/.

bounded-scholarly-source-acquisition.note: Europe PMC, arXiv and DataCite sources in config/source_packs/scientific.json run through the generic HTTPS page adapter.

canonical-economic-indicators.note: register_series is only reached via model.load_fixture; no MCP write path, reads via kb_economic.

claim-observation-links.note: record_economic_link only reached via fixture load; claim_vs_data is a separate generic claim-check path.

complete-snapshot-removal-semantics.note: Implemented in GeospatialFeatureStore.finish_snapshot/tombstone handling; no dedicated tool, applied during source-pack runs.

cultural-object-place-projection.note: Provider coordinates projected into GeospatialStore as points; search filters by place_id/geometry_ids.

explicit-citation-graph.note: legal_citations table; exposed inside inspect_legal_work and citation lookup, no dedicated graph tool.

explicit-withdrawal-refresh-semantics.note: Applied in ProductStore.observe_page/finish_source during runs; no dedicated tool.

formal-library-snapshots.note: FormalLibraryAdapter pinned to commits (Lean/Isabelle/Coq lexical scan).

gated-retrieval-modes.note: Mode states and thresholds come from config/legal/retrieval_modes.json.

incremental-git-ingestion.note: Registered connector; tool exposure is via generic connector/source-pack runners.

math-literature-records.note: ZbmathAdapter; sources declared in config/source_packs/research.json, not scientific.json.

media-provenance-and-reuse.note: Gated imagery tools (reverse_image_search, geolocate_image) are env-gated and not in the generated catalog.

native-wfs-2.0.0-geojson-acquisition.note: WFS adapter is registered as the "wfs" runtime builder; acquisition runs through the generic source-pack tools (config/source_packs/geospatial.json).

official-source-manifests.note: Coverage checked against config/political_sources.json; source pack config/source_packs/political.json is declarative-rest.

openreview-round-comparison.note: OpenReview sources live in config/source_packs/openreview.json, not the science pack's scientific.json.

osv-cve-advisories.note: ingest_advisory has no caller outside its module; advisories are only read (affected_by/fixed_in, inventory impact).

reviewable-boundary-name-resolution.note: resolve_boundary leaves ambiguous names unresolved; the review workflow lives in src/kb/geospatial.py (place resolutions), not in the feature store.

scoped-entity-resolution.note: record_alias/resolve_alias exist but no MCP tool or other module calls them; kb_political only resolves domain scope.

section-addressable-specifications.note: Only generic exposure; kb_technical query "implements" reads specification relations.

source-identity-and-relationships.note: Implemented in the knowledge engine, not the osint server; osint relationship_path is an entity-graph path, not source relationships.

unit-normalized-display-attributes.note: NORMALIZED_UNITS/PRODUCT_UNITS registered in the quantitative store.

implementations_without_string.name: research literature analytics
implementations_without_string.note: Science pack query_examples use citation_graph but no science capability string names it; catalog gates research_mcp on the "research" domain pack.

implementations_without_string.name: osint entity dossier and relationship paths
osint gated geolocation/coordination
implementations_without_string.note: geolocate_claims, narrative_coordination, reverse_image_search, geolocate_image are env-gated and absent from the generated catalog.

implementations_without_string.name: GTFS transit schedules
implementations_without_string.note: GTFS source is in config/source_packs/geospatial.json but the geospatial pack declares no transit string.

implementations_without_string.name: geospatial places, geometries and spatial relations
implementations_without_string.note: Used in geospatial query_examples (search_geospatial_knowledge, calculate_spatial_relation) with no matching string.

server_pack.summary: Only research_mcp is pack-gated (to the "research" src/domains pack, enabled by default in config/domain_packs.json); every other server, including osint_mcp, market_mcp and knowledge_engine_mcp, returns None and is never pack-gated. No packs/ bundle (science, osint, geospatial, legal, products, market, ...) gates any server.

required_data_other_stems.knowledge_engine_mcp: tool-specific branches only for intake-mode, research-loop/budget, decision-watch, review-inbox, authored-report-edit and research-analysis tools (they return knowledge:* scope strings as labels); all pack tools (geospatial, legal, products, science/cultural/math, transit, patents) fall to ["knowledge-engine-runtime"]

catalog_pack_mapping.summary: market_mcp is the only server stem with pack-specific required-data branches (per-store labels); the osint, research and knowledge-engine pack tools get generic labels ("warehouse" / "knowledge-engine-runtime").
